content: Expo Crypto ~57.0.1 now supplies native AES-256-GCM. Argon2id still needs a narrow reviewed native bridge; recommend an app-owned local Expo module backed on Android by Bouncy Castle bcprov-jdk18on 1.85.2, with known-answer vectors and device calibration. Reject stale broad wrappers, JS-thread Argon2, crypto-js, CBC, and weaker silent substitutions.
